plugins.name: Audio Player
plugins.description: Interactive audio player with waveform scrubber, playback rate, volume control, and ID3 metadata display.
plugins.author: Bowerbird Team
plugins.longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Multi-Format Playback**: Native audio playback for MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, AAC, and WebM streams.
- **Interactive Scrubber**: Seamless scrubbing with live timestamp, duration formatting, and keyboard shortcuts (Space to play/pause, Left/Right arrows for seek).
- **Speed & Volume Controls**: Variable playback speed (0.5x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x) with pitch preservation, mute toggle, and smooth volume slider.
- **Metadata Cards**: Displays bitrate, sample rate, channels, duration, and file size in the sidebar inspector.

notes: Initial official release built with @bowerbird/plugin-sdk
Smooth audio waveform scrubber and time display
Variable playback speed and volume memory

plugins.name: Markdown Preview
plugins.description: Rich Markdown preview with syntax highlighting, task lists, frontmatter inspection, and table of contents outline.
plugins.author: Bowerbird Team
plugins.longDescription:
### Key Features
- **GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM)**: Render tables, task lists, strikethrough, blockquotes, and code blocks with syntax highlighting.
- **YAML Frontmatter Extraction**: Automatically parses header frontmatter (title, date, author, tags) and displays structured badge attributes.
- **Document Outline**: Dynamic table of contents parsed from H1-H6 headings with instant click-to-scroll navigation.
- **Full Zoom & Pan**: Interactive viewport zoom controls with mouse wheel or keyboard shortcuts.
- **Copy Formatted Text & Markdown**: Quick action to copy raw markdown or rendered rich text.

notes: Initial official release built with @bowerbird/plugin-sdk
Interactive Viewport with Zoom & Outline support
Inspector Preview with YAML frontmatter badges

plugins.name: Pinterest
plugins.description: Parse Pinterest pin URLs and save the original image into your Bowerbird library.
plugins.author: Bowerbird Team
plugins.longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Pin URL import**: Paste any Pinterest pin URL (regional domains and pin.it short links included) and save the linked image.
- **Original rendition**: Pin pages are resolved to the original `i.pinimg.com/originals/...` image instead of saving a thumbnail or the HTML page.
- **Source URL preserved**: The pin page is stored as the item's source URL while the actual image is downloaded.
- **Inspector shortcut**: Items whose source URL is a Pinterest pin get a one-click **Save image** action.
- **Context menu**: Right-click the canvas and choose **Save Pinterest Pin…** from Plugin Actions.

notes: Initial release
Resolve Pinterest pin pages to their original image and import into Bowerbird
Support pin.it short links and direct i.pinimg.com URLs

plugins.name: AI Prompt Metadata
plugins.description: Extends asset metadata with a dedicated Prompt field for recording and searching AI generation prompts.
plugins.author: Bowerbird Team
plugins.longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Dedicated AI Prompt Field**: Easily record Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, ComfyUI, or custom LLM generation prompts for any image or asset.
- **Compact Height-Capped Read-out**: Long prompts stay inside a fixed-height, scrollable preview so the inspector sidebar never turns into an endless text wall.
- **Expand into a Full Dialog**: One click opens the prompt in a roomy, distraction-free dialog (Esc or backdrop click to close) with its own copy action.
- **One-Click Clipboard Copy**: Copy the full generation prompt at any time, with Copy/Copied feedback and a legacy clipboard fallback.
- **Inspector Integration**: Beautiful, non-intrusive collapsible panel directly in Bowerbird's right inspector sidebar, with auto-save on blur.
- **Searchable Metadata**: Prompts are stored in the asset manifest and seamlessly indexed for keyword search across your entire library.

notes: Header is now icon-free and badge-free: no leading property icon, no character-count badge
Prompt read-out is now height-capped with an Expand dialog for full-length prompts
Copy is a single icon button that swaps to a check mark (Copy/Copied tooltip) with a legacy clipboard fallback
Auto-saving inline editor with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to save and Esc to cancel
Initial official release as a modular metadata extension
Auto-save with character and word counting
Clean Light and Dark mode adaptation

plugins.name: PSD Preview
plugins.description: Native Photoshop (.psd / .psb) preview: renders the flattened composite, reports document properties and exposes the layer tree.
plugins.author: Bowerbird Team
plugins.longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Composite rendering**: reproduces the merged image Photoshop stores inside the file, so what you see is what the designer flattened — no layer flattening needed on our side.
- **Layer tree in the inspector**: reads the layer groups and visibility flags, so you can tell whether the copy you are looking at is the currently-hidden variant.
- **Document properties**: pixel dimensions, color mode (RGB / CMYK / grayscale), bit depth, layer count and whether the document carries alpha transparency.
- **Thumbnail-first inspector**: uses the embedded thumbnail for the right-hand panel so browsing a folder of PSDs stays fast, then upgrades to the full composite once the file is parsed.
- **Zoom & pan**: percentage zoom with fit-to-window, driven by the host's zoom controls.

notes: Initial release built with @bowerbird/plugin-sdk
Composite viewport with zoom & pan
Layer tree + document properties in the inspector
Copy PSD summary context menu action
